resumo:
Software engineer building SaaS for river transportation and port management in the Amazon. I am part of the team that designed and keeps developing an ecosystem connecting ticket e-commerce, port management, financial control and physical access control, serving shipping companies, travel agencies, ports and passengers. I currently balance my main role at W3 Companhia with freelance projects, delivering consistent technical work.

Key contributions:
• Modernized sales processes, creating a more efficient experience for sellers and buyers.
• Faster, more efficient reports, especially over large data volumes.
• Security and consistency improvements that reduced anomalies and increased software reliability.
• Strategic new features that increased operational efficiency and revenue.
afinidades: Optimizing and solving complex SQL queries
Coding challenges focused on logic and algorithms
Analyzing and refactoring code for performance

experiencias.empresa: O Mentor Concursos, Taboão da Serra/SP
experiencias.descricao:
• Restructured the tool architecture of Agente Águia's AI chat: **semantic search, flashcard generation and study summaries**.
• Built Agente Águia's question module: question and exam bank, **automated AI extraction pipeline** and LLM-generated teaching comments.
• Integrated Agente Águia's question bank into Mentor: free-study sessions with filters and **topics pre-selected from the student's history**.

• Designed and built **Boto**, an AI assistant (Gemini) that turns natural-language questions into Eloquent queries with **layered security**: an AST allowlist on generated code, project-ownership scoping, read-only execution with rollback and fail-closed defaults.
• Validated Boto with a **reproducible security test suite**: 40 legitimate questions across 3 access profiles plus an adversarial suite of 6 attack classes (jailbreak, role escalation, cross-project access, prompt extraction) and 20 vectors generated by a different model, comparing runs with and without the layers to detect data leakage.
• Automated **AI document triage**: OCR + LLM check, in an async queue, whether attachments match each request and open a pending issue for the beneficiary; project registration is now filled in from the contract and work plan, budget lines included.
• Built, with the team, the **financial request engine** (Laravel): multi-step, role-based approval with **idempotent debits and refunds** on budget-line and bank-account balances, consistent even when the budget line or amount changes, and contracts that automatically generate each installment's request.
• Integrated bank reconciliation with the **Banco do Brasil APIs** (statements, investments and redemptions via its Funds API) using idempotent operations, plus Sicredi; also built the institutional API with **zero-downtime key rotation**.

• Architected TechRios (SaaS ERP for river transportation): restructured the trips, routes and data pipeline modules, driving +36.7% in transactions vs. 2024.
• Built Porto Fácil, a port management REST API consumed by multiple systems and physical turnstiles, cutting fee reconciliation from hours to minutes.
• Helped restructure Yjara Viagens (ticket e-commerce): API redesign, data modeling and services. Went live in Jun/2025 with +44% in transaction volume.
• Embedded AI into TechRios operations: sales assistance based on the passenger's history and an **in-house MCP server** for natural-language business queries.
• Evolved **W3Zap**, an omnichannel CRM (WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger) based on Ticketz: official WhatsApp API, template campaigns, **AI agents in automations** and voice calls with multi-user management.
• Integrated external systems such as **Dropbox, BP-e (SEFAZ), Safe2Pay and Sicredi**.
• Technologies: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node, Vue, Laravel, Inertia, CSS, MySQL.

• Built full-stack web features with PHP and JavaScript.
• Optimized database queries and structures for efficiency.
• Technologies: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, Ajax, Node, Vue, Laravel, Inertia, CSS, MySQL.

projetos.nome: TechRios – SaaS ERP for river transportation
projetos.descricao: SaaS ERP for shipping companies: companies, agencies, trips, routes, reports and tax invoicing (BP-e/SEFAZ), with AI sales assistance and an MCP server for natural-language queries. +36.7% in transactions vs. 2024.
Backend work: API redesign, data modeling and services. Went live in Jun/2025 with +44% in transaction volume.
AI study platform: question and exam bank with automated extraction and LLM-generated teaching comments, plus a chat with semantic search, flashcards and summaries.

projetos.nome: O Mentor App – Routine and study management for exam candidates
projetos.descricao: Mentoring platform for public-service exam candidates, part of the Agente Águia ecosystem: student onboarding, Routine Planning, a weekly Study Cycle with a timer, a Verticalized Syllabus with progress tracking and free study with the question bank. I worked on the backend (Laravel) and frontend (Next.js) of these modules.

projetos.nome: River FIAM – Financial management for UFOPA projects
projetos.descricao: Financial management platform for research projects at UFOPA's support foundation (Laravel + Vue/Inertia): per-budget-line balances kept consistent on every approval, role-based approval, contracts with installments and a public transparency portal. Highlights: **Boto**, an AI assistant whose queries are guarded by an AST allowlist and validated by adversarial tests, AI document triage and reconciliation integrated with the Banco do Brasil APIs.
Port management REST API consumed by multiple systems and by physical access-control turnstiles, cutting fee reconciliation from hours to minutes.

projetos.nome: W3Zap – AI-powered omnichannel customer service CRM
projetos.descricao: Customer service CRM for WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger built on Ticketz (open source) and evolved for W3's operations: **official WhatsApp API (Cloud API)** alongside Baileys, marketing and utility campaigns with templates segmented by interest and product, **automations with AI agents** that read files, summarize conversations and hand off to humans, **WhatsApp voice calls**, forms, interactive messages, Kanban and queue-based webhook processing.

projetos.nome: RIBBA – Lower Amazon Bioeconomy Innovation Network
projetos.descricao: Institutional platform for the network that connects entrepreneurs, researchers, public and private institutions and the community to boost the Amazon bioeconomy, presenting the network and its partners with a membership form.

Packed-meal ordering system for university dining at UFOPA campuses: weekly menus per campus, online lunch and dinner orders with a cutoff time, ovo-lacto vegetarian option, orders for dependents and payment via PIX.

projetos_codigo.descricao: Open source package published on Packagist that keeps a catalog of Eloquent models in sync with the code: detects changes via git diff, extracts structure (table, fields, relations) through reflection, never from the AI, and uses an LLM to propose business knowledge that is only applied after a human reviews the diff (analyze → review → apply workflow).
HTML/JS simulator of the Knob & Switch Computer: 32-address memory, R0–R3 registers, A/B/C buses and ALU, with continuous or step-by-step execution plus new instructions and flags.
Python GUI (ttkbootstrap + MoviePy) that splits videos into parts by interval and duration and joins the clips into a single file at the original quality, powered by FFmpeg.
Evaluates expressions with decimals, parentheses and the four operators using only recursion and regex, respecting precedence and fixing unbalanced parentheses and repeated signs (-- → +).
Low-level logic experiment: reads two single-digit operands and an operator (+ or −) in ASCII and returns the result as a single digit.
Nearest-Neighbor heuristic for the Traveling Salesman Problem on complete weighted graphs, trying every vertex as the starting point and printing the path and total distance.
